lead: The input area of an AI chat: a rounded shell holding attachments, a textarea that grows with its content, and a toolbar. Enter submits and Shift + Enter inserts a newline, an Enter while an input method is composing doesn't send, and the send button becomes a stop button while the reply is generated.

usage.title: Usage
usage.placeholder: What do you want to know?
usage.footer: AI can make mistakes. Check important info.

streaming.title: Send and stop
streaming.description: With `status="streaming"` the send button becomes a stop button, and Enter can't submit either.
streaming.placeholder: Send a message, then stop it

attachments.title: Attachments and actions
attachments.description: Attachments go in `Composer.Attachments`; when a message with attachments but no text may be sent, compute `canSubmit` yourself.

triggers.title: Mentions and commands
triggers.description: `triggers`: type `@` to pick a person, `/` to pick a command. The candidates appear above the caret; while the list is open Enter selects, and only once it is closed does Enter submit.

submit-on.title: Submit shortcut
submit-on.description: `mod-enter`: Enter inserts a newline and ⌘ / Ctrl + Enter submits (common for long text).

parts.Composer: Root (`form`): holds the value and the status, and submits
parts.Shell: The rounded shell; clicking an empty spot inside focuses the textarea
parts.Attachments: The row above the textarea, for the attachments to send
parts.TextArea: Grows with its content up to `maxRows`, then scrolls inside; Enter while an input method is composing doesn't send
parts.Toolbar: The toolbar below the textarea, with a start and an end group
parts.Action: An icon button in the toolbar (a small, muted Button); `aria-label` is required and it doesn't submit the form
parts.Send: Send button: a submit button when idle (disabled with nothing to send), a stop button while streaming; its name follows the status
parts.Footer: A line of small print below the shell

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.textarea: The textarea (its height is measured and set by the component)
styling.toolbar: The toolbar and its two groups
styling.footer: The small print below the shell
